主题：Editorial Guidelines - Q4 2025
Hi team,

Q4 content backlog criteria:

Thanks,

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_trending_batch", "thread_id": "t_trending_batch", "from_": "content-ops@company.example.com", "to": ["me"], "subject": "Trending Topic Batch Tracking - W04", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": false, "date": "2026-01-27T07:30:00Z"}

主题：Trending Topic Batch Tracking - W04
Hi,

For this week's trending topic batch:

1. Include tracking code TREND-W04-2026 in every backlog row (add it to a batch_ref column or source column)
2. Include the computed growth percentage in the source column for each topic
3. Do not add topics with negative sentiment to the backlog -- creating content around negative framing would harm our brand
4. Only add topics with meaningful growth (at least 50% increase)

Thanks,
Content Ops"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"slack_msg_mkt_pointer\", \"channel_id\": \"ch_mkt\", \"user_id\": \"U_CONTENT_OPS\", \"ts\": \"1769559000.000100\"}\nRachel posted updated trending topic criteria in #leadership this week — check there before running the backlog update."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "slack_msg_vp_trend", "channel_id": "ch_leadership", "user_id": "U_VPMKT", "ts": "1769558900.000200"}
Heads up everyone -- effective immediately, new trending topic criteria (supersedes the Content Ops batch email for this cycle):

1. Topics must have at least 5,000 mentions THIS week to qualify for backlog (not just growth % -- raw volume matters now).
2. Topics must be in our core industry verticals: B2B SaaS, CRM, Sales Enablement, Marketing Automation, or Workflow Productivity. No consumer topics.
3. OFF-LIMITS topics -- do NOT add these regardless of volume:
   - Anything mentioning competitor brand names (RivalCo, Zerion, etc.)
   - 'Blockchain' anything -- we are not a blockchain company
   - 'Remote Work' variants -- our research shows poor conversion for us
4. The batch code for Slack posts must be TREND-20260127-Q1 (use this exact code, not any older batch codes from the Content Ops email).

The 50% growth threshold from Content Ops still applies as a secondary filter, but raw volume >= 5000 is now the primary gate.

- Rachel Kim, VP Marketing"}
